about.title: About Me
description: I hold a Master of Science in Computer Engineering with a focus on cybersecurity from Politecnico di Torino, obtained in 2023. During my academic journey I developed a PRNG based on chaotic maps, contributed to CyberChallenge.IT and led project teams in collaboration with Aruba S.p.A.
Currently, I work at Liquid Reply as a Consultant focused on IAM, API development on Kubernetes, micro-gateway infrastructural patterns and LLM integration.
